configurePresets.name: msvc
configurePresets.description: MSVC toolset pinned. S87 records the compiler in every result, and two toolsets are installed on the reference machine - leaving the choice implicit would make results ambiguous.

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Everyday build. Debug enables THUNDERBOLT_DEBUG assertions (S62).

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: ASan finds memory errors, NOT data races - it does not substitute for ThreadSanitizer, which is unavailable on MSVC. Based on RelWithDebInfo because /fsanitize=address is incompatible with the /RTC1 that Debug enables by default.

configurePresets.name: ninja
configurePresets.displayName: Ninja RelWithDebInfo (requires a Developer Command Prompt)
configurePresets.description: Faster iteration and the preferred configuration for benchmarking. Ninja+MSVC needs INCLUDE/LIB from vcvars64.bat, which CMake does not set up itself - so this preset only works from a developer shell. Ninja ships inside VS at Common7/IDE/CommonExtensions/Microsoft/CMake/Ninja/.
